name: Motor Cycle
description: A self-propelled two- or three-wheeled vehicle designed for the roadway, other than an electric power-assisted cycle or a motorized trail bike. Yukon has no moped tier, so every road-going electric two-wheeler past the e-bike limits, from a slow e-scooter-style moped to a fast e-moto, is one.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and designed to be operated on a roadway; one designed or adapted solely for use off the roadway is a motorized trail bike instead
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1

restrictions.rule: No minimum or maximum motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1

restrictions.rule: A motor vehicle: riders need an operator's licence for its class
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, ss. 1 and 5

restrictions.rule: Must be registered, and its owner must carry motor vehicle liability insurance
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, ss. 39 and 72

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear a prescribed helmet securely attached
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, ss. 199 and 199.01

restrictions.rule: Its lamps must be lit whenever it's moving on a highway
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 178(2)

restrictions.rule: Riders go single file, and a passenger must ride on a regular seat
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, ss. 144.01 and 193
